#| fig-width: 8
#| fig-height: 10

#| 

 data_tiles <- mpxnyc::community_sf_obj %>%
   transmute(to_community = community, from_community = community) %>%
   expand(to_community, from_community) %>%
   mutate(
     from_borough = str_sub(from_community, 1, 2),
     to_borough   = str_sub(to_community, 1, 2)
     ) %>%
   mutate(borough = ifelse(from_borough == to_borough, from_borough, "Between"))



nodes_home <-  targets::tar_read(places_data) %>% 
  transmute(neighborhood = home_neighborhood, community = home_community, borough = home_borough)

nodes_place <-  targets::tar_read(places_data) %>% 
  transmute(neighborhood = place_neighborhood, community = place_community, borough = place_borough)

nodes <- nodes_home %>% 
  rbind(nodes_place) %>%
  mutate(name = community) %>%
  select(name) 

main_data <- targets::tar_read(places_data) %>%
  transmute(from = home_community, to = place_community) %>%
  group_by(from, to) %>%
  summarize(weight = n()) %>%
  tbl_graph(edges = .) %>%
  mutate(borough = str_sub(name, 1, 2)) %>%
  mutate(deg = igraph::strength(.)) %>%
  arrange(borough) %>%
  activate(edges) %>%
  mutate(from_borough = .N()$borough[from], to_borough = .N()$borough[to]) %>%
  mutate(borough = ifelse(from_borough == to_borough, from_borough, "Between")) %>%
  mutate(from_name = .N()$name[from], to_name = .N()$name[to]) %>%
  data.frame() 

main_data %>%
  ggplot() +
    geom_tile(aes(y = from_community, x = to_community, fill = borough), data = data_tiles) + 
    geom_point(aes(y =from_name, x = to_name, size = weight), color = "white", data = main_data, alpha = 0.7) +
      geom_point(aes(y =from_name, x = to_name, size = weight), color = "black", data = main_data %>% filter(borough == "Between"), alpha = 0.5) +
    theme_void() +
  scale_color_manual(values = c(
                                              "BK" = mpxnyc_colors$dark_blue, 
                                              "BX" = mpxnyc_colors$dark_pink, 
                                              "MN" = mpxnyc_colors$dark_purple, 
                                              "QN" = mpxnyc_colors$light_orange, 
                                              "SI" = mpxnyc_colors$dark_green, 
                                              "Between" = "white"
                                              )) +
  
  scale_fill_manual(values = c(
                                              "BK" = mpxnyc_colors$dark_blue, 
                                              "BX" = mpxnyc_colors$dark_pink, 
                                              "MN" = mpxnyc_colors$dark_purple, 
                                              "QN" = mpxnyc_colors$light_orange, 
                                              "SI" = mpxnyc_colors$dark_green, 
                                              "Between" = "white"
                                              )) +
  scale_edge_color_manual(values = c(
    mpxnyc_colors$dark_blue, 
                                              "BK" = mpxnyc_colors$dark_blue, 
                                              "BX" = mpxnyc_colors$dark_pink, 
                                              "MN" = mpxnyc_colors$dark_purple, 
                                              "QN" = mpxnyc_colors$light_orange, 
                                              "SI" = mpxnyc_colors$dark_green, 
                                              "Between" = "white"
    )
  ) +
  theme(
    axis.text = element_text(size = 7, color = "black"),
    axis.text.x = element_text(angle = 90),
    axis.title = element_text(),
    axis.title.y = element_text(angle = 90),
    legend.position = "none"
  ) +
  scale_x_discrete("Destination community district", position = "top") +
  scale_y_discrete("Origin community district",  limits=rev) + 
      ggplot2::theme(
        plot.title = element_text(hjust = 0.5),
        plot.subtitle = element_text(hjust = 0.5, margin = margin(1, 0, 15, 0)),
        plot.caption = element_text(margin = margin(15, 0, 0, 0)),
        axis.title.y = element_text(margin = margin(0, 5, 0, 0, "mm")),
        axis.title.x = element_text(margin = margin(0, 0, 5, 0, "mm")),
      ) + 
    labs(
      title    = captions_and_titles("matrixneighborhood")$title,
      subtitle = captions_and_titles("matrixneighborhood")$subtitle,
      caption  = captions_and_titles("matrixneighborhood")$caption
    )
